bends.note: gentle curve: Reading runs NNE (dx/dy ~-0.17) from Dandridge to the top edge, and nearer due north (dx/dy ~-0.10) from East 13th to the bottom edge; vertex of the two straight legs

ends.note: north end at the C.L.& N. R.R. main tracks; its east line stops at a lot line at ~(2829,1982)
paper street (sheet 159 outline) ends at the wooden steps on the line of Liberty Street

notes: Deer Creek valley between Reading Road (west) and Gilbert Avenue (east), mostly C.L.& N. R.R. yard, coal yards and industry. The top street is printed 'ELSINORE PL. (AV.)'; named Elsinore Avenue to match sheet 159 ('ELSINORE AV.'); 100 ft, it meets Reading Road from the east. Elsinore also runs east to Gilbert at the top-right corner, but the Gilbert/Elsinore centreline crossing (est. ~3779,162) falls just above the top paper edge (~y 170), so it is not listed. Dandridge (printed 'DANDRIDGE', 35') and the street printed 'WOODWARD' (60') come in from sheet 154 and end at Reading Road's west side; 'WOODWARD' is named East 13th Street as on 154 ('E. 13TH (WOODWARD)'). The 10-13 ft alley at the bottom-left (~y 4414 at Reading) is unlabelled here; it is named Anna Alley because its spacing from East 13th matches 154's Anna Alley/Reading Road T. Sheet 154 also has Noah Alley reaching Reading Road between Dandridge and East 13th, but on this sheet the block line on the west side of Reading is unbroken from Dandridge to East 13th, so no point is given. The wooden-steps strip on the line of Liberty Street (~11 ft, 12 in. water pipe, label '...RTY' beside it at the left edge) runs ENE from the left margin to Reading Road's west side at ~(1122,2330); listed under alleys (unnamed), drawn to the Reading Road centreline. Section (paper street, sheet 159 outline) ends at that strip. Gilbert Avenue (printed 'GILBERT AV.', 100') runs down the east side; Eden Park lies east of it at the top. East 6th Street (printed 'E. 6TH ST.', ~55 ft, 6 in. pipe along its centre) leaves Gilbert's east side SSE between block corners at ~(3865,2796) and ~(3840,3279); T point where its centreline (taken along the pipe) meets the Gilbert centreline. Accomodation is printed 'ACCOMODATION' (40', 4 in. pipe); it runs SSE from the railroad (north end listed under ends) to the bottom edge, where the wedge block between it and Gilbert ends in a point at ~(3444,4232); the Accomodation/Gilbert centreline meeting is off this sheet (it is on sheet 150). Deer Creek Road is printed 'DEER CREEK R'D (NOT OPENED)', 60 ft, drawn only in dashed lines from about y~2030 (under pastes) to about y~3850, where it fades out under the coal bunkers; it meets no street, so no points are given.
